questions.prompt: Explain how multiplying both sides of x/(x - 2) + 1 = 2/(x - 2) by x - 2 creates an extraneous solution.
questions.prompt_markup: Explain how multiplying both sides of x/(x - 2) + 1 = 2/(x - 2) by x - 2 creates an extraneous solution.
questions.correct_answer: Multiplying by x - 2 is not reversible when x - 2 = 0, so the new equation is true at x = 2 although the original is undefined there.

questions.prompt: Explain why x/(x - 2) + 1 = 2/(x - 2) has no solution using the graphs of y = x/(x - 2) + 1 and y = 2/(x - 2).
questions.prompt_markup: Explain why x/(x - 2) + 1 = 2/(x - 2) has no solution using the graphs of y = x/(x - 2) + 1 and y = 2/(x - 2).
questions.correct_answer: For x ≠ 2 the left side minus the right side is (2x - 4)/(x - 2) = 2, so the graphs never meet; at x = 2 neither is defined.
